name: opskitty
description: Uptime checks for sites and APIs, status pages, cron heartbeats, Lighthouse and SEO audits.

interface.shortDescription: Uptime, status pages and SEO audits
interface.longDescription: Set up monitoring by asking for it. Watch sites and API endpoints, get Slack or email alerts, publish a status page, track cron jobs with heartbeats, and run Lighthouse and SEO audits.
defaultPrompt: Monitor my site every minute and alert me on Slack if it goes down
Create a public status page for my API
Run Lighthouse on my homepage and list the top fixes
